.Net Developer 
 

  - On behalf of our client in the Oil and Gas sector Procom Services is looking for a .Net Developer with SQL Server and Oracle experience. The successful candidate will be proficient in .NET Development, C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Microsoft Visual Studio 2012, SQL Server technologies (SSRS, SSIS, and SQL Server), Microsoft Team Foundation Server, and Oracle.
 

  .Net Developer Job Details 
 

 Design and develop Windows applications, web applications, and web services.
 Support and configure COTS solutions.
 Analyzing business requirements, recommending technical solutions and writing technical specifications. 
 Work with team members and internal customers gathering requirements.
  
 .Net Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 Proficient in .NET Development, C#, VB.NET, and ASP.NET.
 SQL Server and Oracle.
 SQL Server technologies including (SSRS and SSIS)
 N-Tier Development Experience
 Full Life Cycle (SDLC) Microsoft .NET application design and development experience.
 Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business or other related computer fields. 
  
 .Net Developer Nice to Have Skills 
 

 Experience within the pipeline sector
  
  .Net Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
